item.title: Late Night, But All Right
item.description: Read Late Night, But All Right In the wee hours of one of my shifts, a thirty-ish woman who appeared to be traveling for business pulled off the interstate to grab some shut-eye. I (forty-ish woman then) worked with a night window and used my judgment on whether anyone was allowed in the lobby. Read Late Night, But All Right

item.title: Results May Be Visible
item.description: Read Results May Be Visible I'm a pest control operations manager. A call gets escalated to me from a furious customer. Customer: "Your guys have come out here to treat my house! I'm furious!" Read Results May Be Visible

item.title: Commission Impossible, Part 3
item.description: Read Commission Impossible, Part 3 Boss: "We can't exactly go rewarding you with commission on an apartment you sold to your friends." Me: "Why? How is that any different from you selling that house to the owner of the golf club you go to?" Boss: "That's different." Read Commission Impossible, Part 3

item.title: Don’t Fall For The Frappe Trap
item.description: Read Don’t Fall For The Frappe Trap Customer: "Yeah… I'll get a venti mocha Frappuccino, double blended, with java chips, add white mocha, add caramel syrup, add hazelnut syrup, made with heavy cream, extra whipped cream on bottom and top, cookie crumble topping, caramel crunch topping, mocha drizzle, caramel drizzle, and one shot poured on top." Read Don’t Fall For The Frappe Trap

item.title: Husband Has Left The Chat
item.description: Read Husband Has Left The Chat Me: "We only have the one warehouse in the country, ma'am. That's why we can only guarantee delivery on Monday." Caller: "Well, where is the warehouse?!" Me: "It’s two thousand miles from you." Caller: "…" Read Husband Has Left The Chat
